scope: G02 text-link and image insertion basics; shared edit-context correctness across breakpoints

facts: Text link dialog requires URL and display text and exposes isNewWindow; image links omit text.
Image insertion offers file and URL modes, maxFileSize=1048576, default onceImageUploadLimit=10. Description image paste uses the same 1048576 byte limit.
Source file picker allows jpg/jpeg/png/gif; existing local WebP support retained.

changes: Existing link dialog now edits display text and opening target; unchanged selected text keeps formatting and native undo.
Image picker stages multiple files or a HTTP(S) image URL; cancel leaves original content unchanged and a failed addition retains existing staged files.
File selection and clipboard files share type/count/size validation and reading; asynchronous paste does not overwrite changed form content.
Semantically unchanged sanitized blur no longer emits an edit or closes an opened dialog.
Shared designer panels retain the selected editing panel when moving to narrow width; untouched mobile canvas remains clear.

verified: Existing ordinary link prepopulates text, URL and new-window setting; cancellation preserves all values.
Changed display text and target=_self survive native undo/redo, save and cold reload.

File picker is multiple. Exactly 1MB accepted into staging; 1MB+1 rejected while accepted selection remains. 11 small files rejected; 10 accepted and further selection disabled. Cancelling these staged files leaves original description unchanged.

Two small PNG files insert together and load. Real image/png clipboard paste inserts once; user clipboard restored afterwards. Saved/cold-reloaded description retains the original and three added embedded images.
Invalid image URL remains correctable. Actual local HTTP image URL is inserted from the 390x844 dialog and loads.

Initial breakpoint reproduction hid editor and URL confirmation did not apply; fixed at useDesignerPanels. Post-fix same desktop-to-mobile confirmation writes successfully, save/cold reload retains all five images.
V5 actual fill retains same-window text link and all five loaded images; submitted one record with child value 网址图片 / 本地多图 / 剪贴板; cold reload and edit retain five images.
V4 record inspected without saving: original text, URL, new-window target and single description image retained.
Viewport restored; browser warning/error logs empty.

limits: Exactly 1MB and ten-file selection boundaries verified, but maximum 10x1MB insertion/publication persistence not verified. Descriptions still embed data URLs in localStorage-backed workspace; quota and file hosting parity remain R7 obligations.
HTTP image was an existing local guide asset, not proof of remote protected-image delivery.
Description word limits, complete type/layout/permission combinations and precise same-state visual match remain G02/R5/R6.
Backend build passed; database/HTTP and full local-to-server migration not exercised.
Vite chunk-size warning remains; overall form-designer acceptance is incomplete.
